note: Two variables claim the column `Del` in `amb` in 2019: k1 (`Del`), which alone holds it in 2018, and k2 (`Delsumma`), documented only there. The neighbouring-owner rule gives the column to k1 and shadows k2's listing as a duplicate, so ordering 2018..2019 is one entry over both years with the widest length (3) and no finding. Fails if the rule stops placing the column (`ambiguous_window`), places it under k2, or splits the entry at 2019. Oracle: the fixture's JSONL and crates/DESIGN.md, Identity (neighbouring owner; maintainer 2026-11-14).
